title: Gen-DD
fill_note: DENSE layered wind with a jig; scorer cap 0.65
fill_how: The scored turns assume a dense, layer-by-layer wind at fill 0.65 (insulated-wire area / window; the scorer cap). Use a winding jig on a drill/lathe with a turn counter, lay each layer side-by-side with light back-tension, and do not scramble-wind: a scramble wind only reaches ≈0.55–0.60 and then the window holds fewer turns (scorer what-if `--fill 0.60` is in the table above). Never wind more than the listed turns — the copper must stay below the flanges.
steel_extra: **New steel:** Ø247 discs, M3 clamp map R30 at 0/90/180/270° and R44 on the inter-pole angles 67.5/112.5/247.5/292.5° (both inside the R86 magnet ring). Cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf`; no earlier disc fits.
o5_note: 48 DIAMETRIC Ø5×5 fitted, 3 per inter-pole gap (R87.6/93.8/100), Halbach-oriented (rule engraved on every arc); if yours are AXIAL, leave them out (see the --halbach none what-if)
card_title: Gen-DD · 8p/12c · INVERTED triple pole R86 + WIDE outer stator · 24 AWG
idea: Gen-DA's inverted triple pole (Ø20 N52 inside, N42 block, N52 60×10×3 bar outermost) pushed out to R86 with the whole coil moved OUTWARD (bobbins r68–122.25 instead of r61–117) and a slightly SHORTER radial build (16.0 mm, 240 t): the coil sides now sit under the faster, larger-radius outer bar flux while the shorter build keeps the wire inside one 390 m spool (scans c1/c2/c4/c5, 432 combos past last night's grid edge).
steel_note: Steel: 2× Ø247 × 4.76 mm (3/16") mild-steel discs, clamp map hub M3 at R22 0/90/180/270°, 4× Ø4.3 brace holes R18 at 45/135/225/315°, 16 arc-clamp M3 at R86 ±13° from every pole, index notch at +X — cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf` (laser-cut service, or any shop that cuts 3/16" mild steel). Lobed arcs: 2.4 mm PLA around each pocket; the epoxy-to-steel bond, not the PLA, holds the magnets. NEW larger discs (bars reach R121.0); the Ø236 Gen-DA discs do NOT fit. Note the Gen-DF rotor uses the same Ø247 OD but a different clamp-bolt radius (R97) — cut the DXF of the rotor you build.
retro_md:
## Modular notes (Gen-DD)

New rotors (16 inverted triple-pole arcs, Ø247 steel), new 24 AWG stator and gap sleeve (8.10 mm, same as Gen-DA). Hubs, shaft, collars, bearing bridges and standoffs are Gen-CS/CP/CZ/DA family parts (same D-flat 8 mm shaft, same hub bolt map). **Gen-DF is a drop-in rotor pair for THIS stator** (same gap, frame, standoffs). Not interchangeable with Gen-DA rotors (R81 vs R86; the Gen-DA rotor on this stator was not scored). Swap stators/rotors with the 4 temporary M4 jack rods: raise rotor B on the nuts (clap hazard in reverse, never by hand), swap the part, lower rotor B, remove the rods.
halb_block:
halbach_magnetisation = "diametric"; // O5x5 assist magnets MUST be DIAMETRICALLY magnetised (tangential)
rotor_b_same_axis   = true;     // same-index magnets share one axis: N faces S across the gap
small_block:
R_small_inner       = 87.6;
R_small_mid         = 93.8;
R_small_outer       = 100.0;
small_r_list        = [R_small_inner, R_small_mid, R_small_outer];   // O5 pockets between poles
// --- N42 rectangular BLOCK magnets (2026-10-16/18): one 20x10x5 block per pole on the pole angle, next to the O20 disc ---
block_R_list        = [101.6];   // block centre radius (pole angle); same polarity as its O20 -> radially extended pole (scorer position = pushed-apart magnet centre)
block_angle_list    = [0];
block_radial        = 10.0;    // block side that runs RADIALLY (mm)
block_tangential    = 20.0;    // block side that runs TANGENTIALLY (mm)
block_h             = 5.0;     // magnetised through the 5 mm thickness (axial), = magnet_h_large so it sits on the steel
block_Br            = 1.29;    // N42 remanence (1.28-1.32 T); scorer models it as a magpylib Cuboid
block_pocket_clear  = 0.3;    // pocket = block + 0.3 mm each way (+ 1.2 mm corner reliefs)
keyhole_pocket      = true;     // 2026-10-18: disc + block share ONE keyhole pocket (hull); they repel onto the far walls
disc_pocket_shift   = 0.00;    // disc pocket centre offset (radial) so the pushed-apart disc sits at R_large
block_pocket_shift  = -0.15;    // block pocket centre offset so the pushed-apart block sits at block_R_list (scorer position)
// --- N52 60x10x3 BARS (2026-10-21, physics_scorer block2 group): one per pole, OUTSIDE the O20, 60 mm side TANGENTIAL ---
block2_R_list       = [112.2];   // bar centre radius (pushed onto the outer pocket wall by its disc)
block2_angle_list   = [0];
block2_radial       = 10.0;     // bar 10 mm side radial
block2_tangential   = 60.0;     // bar 60 mm side tangential
block2_h            = 3.0;      // magnetised through the 3 mm thickness (axial); gap face FLUSH with the disc face
block2_Br           = 1.43;     // N52
block2_pocket_clear = 0.3;
block2_pocket_depth = 3.05;     // BLIND pocket from the stator face: bar sits on a 1.95 mm PLA floor over the steel
block2_pocket_shift = -0.15;    // pocket centre -0.15 -> outer wall at R + 5.0 (pushed-out bar sits exactly at block2_R_list)
block2_merge_in     = 0.45;     // pocket inner wall extended inward so it opens into the disc pocket (no PLA sliver)
eng_a = 4.6; eng_L = 5.0; eng_ta = 4.6; eng_tr = -12;   // engraving (O5 arrow + N/S letter) on the POLE side of the O5 column
